description: This Java source file defines the PromoServices class, which provides various static methods for managing product promotion codes within the OFBiz framework. The methods include creating promo code sets, purging old promos, importing promo codes from files, and associating promo codes with emails. It interacts with the database, services, and utility classes to perform these operations.

classes.name: PromoServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing product promotion codes, including creation, import, and cleanup operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createProductPromoCodeSet
methods.description: Generates a set of unique promo codes based on specified parameters, ensuring uniqueness and creating promo code entries in the system.

methods.name: purgeOldStoreAutoPromos
methods.description: Removes expired promotional applications associated with a specific product store.

methods.name: importPromoCodesFromFile
methods.description: Imports promo codes from an uploaded file, creating promo code entries for each valid line.

methods.name: importPromoCodeEmailsFromFile
methods.description: Associates email addresses from an uploaded file with a specific promo code, creating contact mechanisms as needed.
